_comment: Fork this file per brand. Point savedSearchIds at your own Meltwater saved searches, set the competitor watchlist, and (optionally) restyle via `theme`. Nothing here is Meltwater-customer-specific — 'Northwind Coffee' is a fictional demo brand.
name: Northwind Coffee
_savedSearches_note: Replace with your real Meltwater saved-search IDs. The brand search is the sole authority on relevance — the agent queries it with query:'*' so results sort purely by the requested metric (see exec_media_brief.py).
_theme_note: Optional CSS-variable overrides — omit any key for the neutral default. See README 'Theme colours' for what each paints. `primary` is the main brand accent (pills, kickers, links, buttons); `ink` is the dark surfaces (masthead glance boxes, bottom-line panel). Sentiment colours (green/red/grey) are fixed and not themeable.
